clue.text: Complete, or with gap?

parts.note: a hole is a gap or opening

explanation.surface: A question of whether something is finished or still has a gap in it.
explanation.definitionFit: Something entire, lacking no part, is complete.

clue.text: Domestic chore that may leave all drained

definitions.text: Domestic chore that may leave all drained

parts.words: Domestic chore that may leave all drained
parts.note: the dishes are left to drain after this household job, while the surface suggests exhausted people

explanation.surface: A household task that leaves everyone exhausted.
explanation.definitionFit: Cleaning the dishes after a meal is a household chore, the plates then set on a rack to drain.

clue.text: Long ago, round the bend

parts.note: O is round in shape
a fold is a bend or crease

explanation.surface: Someone went mad a long time ago.
explanation.walkthrough: 'round the bend' looks like the idiom for mad, but it is two separate pieces.
explanation.definitionFit: A phrase for times past, meaning formerly or in olden days.

clue.text: Loss of overhead light is naturally temporary

definitions.text: Loss of overhead light is naturally temporary

parts.words: Loss of overhead light is naturally temporary
parts.note: describes a natural event in which the sun or moon is briefly blotted out, read as if about a ceiling lamp failing

explanation.surface: A broken ceiling light is only a temporary problem.
explanation.definitionFit: When the moon passes before the sun, daylight is briefly lost, a natural and passing event.

clue.text: Abhorrent ruling to imprison reversed before magistrates

indicators.note: to imprison means one piece is locked up inside the other

parts.note: regnant means reigning or ruling

indicators.note: reversed tells us the phrase for being in court is read backwards

parts.note: to be up before the magistrates is to be on trial in court, so up

explanation.surface: A nasty ruling to jail someone, overturned when they come before the bench.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Up before the magistrates' is British for appearing in a lower court; 'reversed' turns that word round, and 'to imprison' lodges it after the first two letters of the word for ruling.
explanation.definitionFit: Both words are adjectives for something deeply offensive or loathsome.

clue.text: Regular payment to retain, say, acting chief

indicators.note: to retain means the first piece holds the second inside it

parts.note: rent is paid regularly
eg, for example, is signalled by say

explanation.surface: A regular salary paid to keep an acting boss in post.
explanation.definitionFit: One who rules in place of a monarch who is a minor or absent is an acting head of state.

clue.text: Quietly tell boy to repair spare tyre

parts.note: p, piano, means quietly in music

indicators.note: to repair suggests fixing by putting the letters into a new order

explanation.surface: Quietly asking a boy to mend a spare tyre.
explanation.definitionFit: A spare tyre is jokey slang for a roll of fat round the waist, a paunch.

clue.text: In delight, soldier finding site of massacre

indicators.note: in means the soldier sits inside the word for delight

parts.note: glee is delight
an NCO, non-commissioned officer, is a soldier

explanation.surface: A soldier delighted to find the site of a massacre.
explanation.walkthrough: Glencoe is a Scottish glen where the MacDonalds were massacred in 1692.
explanation.definitionFit: The glen in the Scottish Highlands is famous as the site of a 1692 massacre.

clue.text: Corrective treatment — maybe fifth taken by US criminal

definitions.meaning: a correction or change for the better

definitions.text: maybe fifth taken by US criminal
definitions.meaning: an American suspect pleads the Fifth, the article of the US Constitution protecting against self-incrimination

explanation.surface: An American criminal undergoing corrective treatment, perhaps drinking a fifth of whisky.
explanation.walkthrough: A 'fifth' is also a US bottle size, adding to the misdirection.
explanation.definitionFit: A correction to a text, and the name for each added article of the US Constitution.

clue.text: Give evidence, but not if in bad temper

indicators.note: but not means the following word is removed

parts.note: to testify is to give evidence
taken as written

explanation.surface: A witness gives evidence, though not if they are in a bad mood.
explanation.definitionFit: Irritable and short-tempered describes someone in a bad mood.

clue.text: Lit up in public here — a little offence involving cannabis

indicators.note: involving means the first piece wraps round the drug

parts.note: a slight is a small snub or offence
pot is slang for cannabis

explanation.surface: A minor drug offence, smoking a joint publicly.
explanation.walkthrough: The surface suggests someone lighting up a joint in public; in fact the definition describes a stage light picking out a performer.
explanation.definitionFit: A spotlight is the beam under which a performer stands illuminated before an audience.

clue.text: Some chance rugby competition won't start

indicators.note: won't start means the first letter is dropped

parts.note: sevens is the seven-a-side form of rugby union, played in tournaments

explanation.surface: There is some chance a rugby tournament will be called off.
explanation.definitionFit: Betting odds of evens give a fifty-fifty chance, so some chance.

clue.text: Film to see as soon as one reaches eighteen?

definitions.text: Film to see as soon as one reaches eighteen?

parts.words: Film to see as soon as one reaches eighteen?
parts.note: a film title read as the day one comes of age and becomes free of parents, as well as an 18-certificate film one may now watch

explanation.surface: A film rated for adults, watched the day one turns eighteen.
explanation.walkthrough: The surface suggests an 18-certificate film; the answer is a blockbuster whose title also fits the day a young adult gains freedom.
explanation.definitionFit: This is a 1996 science-fiction movie, and figuratively the day a person reaches adulthood.

clue.text: Stake on rock is place of execution

indicators.note: in an across clue, on means placed after

parts.note: the Rock is Gibraltar, Gib for short
a stake is a bet

explanation.surface: Putting a wager on a rock where executions happen.
explanation.definitionFit: A gallows-like post where hanged bodies were displayed marks a place of execution.

clue.text: Mania for cooking cheese without double boiler

indicators.note: without, meaning outside, means the cheese is wrapped round the other letters

parts.note: Brie is a French cheese

indicators.note: for cooking tells us these letters are mixed up

explanation.surface: A craze for cooking with cheese, but not a double boiler.
explanation.walkthrough: 'without' reads as lacking but here means outside; 'for cooking' rearranges the mania into AINMA. The surface's kitchen talk fits, since the answer is itself a cooking vessel.
explanation.definitionFit: A pan set in hot water for gentle cooking is a double boiler.

clue.text: Very quick to get out of exam

parts.note: to flee is to run away or get out
a test is an exam

explanation.surface: Wanting to escape an exam as fast as possible.
explanation.definitionFit: The superlative of fleet, meaning swift, describes the very quickest.

clue.text: Nominally anti-war author?

parts.note: a novelist whose middle name means making peace, so his name alone suggests opposition to war

explanation.surface: A writer whose name suggests opposition to war.
explanation.walkthrough: The Victorian novelist William Makepeace Thackeray, author of Vanity Fair, carries a peacemaking middle name.
explanation.definitionFit: The author of Vanity Fair, whose middle name was Makepeace.

clue.text: Sort of garment in which one escapes unharmed?

definitions.text: Sort of garment in which one escapes unharmed?

parts.words: Sort of garment in which one escapes unharmed?
parts.note: a swimsuit made as a single garment, and the idiom for coming through intact

explanation.surface: A garment that keeps its wearer safe from harm.
explanation.definitionFit: A single-piece swimsuit; to escape intact is to come out of something whole.

clue.text: Force open sealed container it's undamaged

indicators.note: sealed means the first piece closes around the second

parts.note: to prise is to force open with a lever
a tin is a container

explanation.surface: Someone forces open a sealed tin and finds the contents intact.
explanation.definitionFit: Something in mint, perfect condition is untouched and unspoilt.

clue.text: The long and the short of metrical analysis

definitions.text: The long and the short of metrical analysis

parts.words: The long and the short of metrical analysis
parts.note: the idiom for a summary, read literally as a verse foot of a long syllable followed by a short one

explanation.surface: A summing up of the study of poetic metre.
explanation.definitionFit: In prosody this foot is one stressed or long syllable followed by an unstressed or short one.

clue.text: Dowry not available to a Venetian heiress

indicators.note: not means the following word is taken away

parts.note: a portion is a dowry given to a bride
on means available, as in a dish being on

explanation.surface: A Venetian heiress whose dowry cannot be had.
explanation.walkthrough: Portia is the rich heiress of Belmont in Shakespeare's The Merchant of Venice.
explanation.definitionFit: The wealthy heroine of a Shakespeare comedy set around Venice.

clue.text: Not entirely cover part of body

definitions.text: Not entirely cover part of body

indicators.note: not entirely means the word loses one of its letters, here the first

parts.note: the lap is the part of the body formed when sitting

explanation.surface: A garment that does not completely cover part of the body.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Not entirely' cuts COVER down to OVER; the whole clue then also defines the answer.
explanation.definitionFit: To lie partly over something is to cover it only in part.

clue.text: One making cuts keeps right away from central casting

indicators.note: casting, as in throwing about, tells us the remaining letters are rearranged
away from means the letter is removed from the word that follows

explanation.surface: A film editor who makes cuts keeps away from the central casting department.
explanation.walkthrough: 'away from' removes R from CENTRAL to leave CENTAL; 'casting' rearranges that into the answer.
explanation.definitionFit: A surgeon's small two-edged knife is an instrument for making cuts.

clue.text: ,The vulgar take position with reserve in assembly of quality extraction

parts.note: the common people, the vulgar herd
a place is a position
to book is to reserve

explanation.surface: The common people take their seats with reserve at a gathering of high birth.
explanation.walkthrough: 'quality extraction' suggests aristocratic descent, but it means fine extracts: the definition is a collection of choice quotations.
explanation.definitionFit: A notebook where memorable passages and quotations are collected is a gathering of choice excerpts.

clue.text: Distressed workers put out begging bowl, perhaps

indicators.note: put here means one piece is placed inside the other

parts.note: a begging bowl is an example of a cup

indicators.note: out signals that the union letters are turned the other way round

explanation.surface: Workers in distress after being laid off, reduced to a begging bowl.
explanation.walkthrough: TU (trade union) is a crossword convention for workers; 'out' turns it round to UT before 'put' places it in the cup.
explanation.definitionFit: Being upset and very distressed is informally described as cut up.

clue.text: Having chosen dictionary, point, inside it

indicators.note: inside means the point is placed within the dictionary

parts.note: the OED is the Oxford English Dictionary

explanation.surface: Having picked a dictionary, someone points at a word inside it.
explanation.definitionFit: Opted is the past form of choosing, as in having made one's choice.

clue.text: Such a love song may get one glowing

definitions.meaning: a sentimental ballad of unrequited love, the kind a singer carries a flame for
a hand-held lamp or flaming brand gives a glow

explanation.surface: A love song that may set a listener aglow.
explanation.definitionFit: The word names both a lament of unrequited love and a portable light.

clue.text: Set a carol for dancing in effortless steps

indicators.note: for dancing tells us the letters move about into a new order

explanation.surface: A carol arranged for dancing in light, easy steps.
explanation.definitionFit: A moving staircase carries people up without effort.

clue.text: Find page and go back with books, in case one may need to quote

definitions.text: case one may need to quote

parts.note: to recede is to go back or withdraw
NT, the New Testament, is a set of books

explanation.surface: Instructions to find a page and look back through books for a quotation.
explanation.definitionFit: An earlier legal ruling cited as an authority is a case one quotes.

clue.text: Get fork out to go round boundaries of deluged field

indicators.note: to go round means the first piece encircles the second

parts.note: to fork out is to pay

indicators.note: boundaries of means the first and last letters of the next word

explanation.surface: Paying someone to walk round the edge of a flooded field.
explanation.definitionFit: A rice field, flooded for planting, is called a paddy.
